scope: Native virtual-binary-heap threshold arithmetic and fresh offheap construction pressure in the owned single-generation collector. Not guest binary construction, a hard quota, generational GC or complete instruction-work policy.
adaptations: Each C process owns a bin_vheap_sz threshold, initially 46422 words, the native default after heap-size rounding. The threshold is a soft collection trigger, not a memory quota. There is no mutable global configuration or old-generation threshold in this one-generation profile.

do_next_vheap_size keeps the native integer comparisons: grow while used/3 > threshold/4 by binary64 1.618, halve below threshold/4, otherwise retain; the result is clamped to the minimum. The owned helper normalizes sub-minimum input thresholds before arithmetic.

Unsigned compiler128 arithmetic emulates both nearest/ties-even binary64 roundings (Uint64 conversion and multiplication), then truncates. The literal significand is 0x19e353f7ced917 / 2^52, not the different exact rational 1618/1000. Intermediate values occupy at most 118 bits. This avoids ambient rounding/exception flags and any fallible fenv operation after collector forwarding has begun.

Native out-of-range double-to-Uint64 conversion is undefined C before its wrap test. The owned helper checks the rounded wide result and stops growing at the previous threshold without performing that conversion. No-progress growth also terminates. Tests use the same explicit overflow guard in the floating reference rather than executing undefined native conversion.

Successful collection updates the threshold after both offheap sweeps, using retained capacity in ordinary plus writable chains. This deliberately retains the existing owned spare-capacity accounting; it is not native apparent-size accounting or a shrink/density claim. Failed tospace allocation leaves heap, threshold and counters unchanged.

Fresh offheap construction checks native >= pressure with overflow-safe subtraction before its final fallible heap reservation. Incoming bytes are rounded down to words as in the native NBYTES(bits)/sizeof(Eterm) expression. Detached zeroed backing is released if pressure-triggered collection fails; outputs and pending credit remain unchanged. Small heap binaries and writable/append helper collection triggers remain as before. A large incoming binary may trigger collection even when existing live usage is zero; no post-allocation quota refusal is fabricated.

Tests compare 20000 random vectors plus rounding/hysteresis boundaries against independent binary64 arithmetic under the default environment, check overflow-safe pressure against compiler128 sums, and preserve rounding modes/exception flags. Real process tests trigger collection despite ample heap space, inject backing and tospace allocation failures with same-process retry, execute identity BEAM, grow/shrink on moving GC, retain pinned writable spare capacity, and physically retire all ownership. Binary construction dispatch remains unadmitted.
